services.name: The Great Scott - 13 Pax With Captain
services.desc: The Great Scott is a 42 foot Bluewater Cabin Cruiser with a bathroom on board. The indoor cabin has heating and cooling depending on the everchanging Lake Tahoe weather. It is large and spacious for the panoramic viewing of the beautiful surrounding mountains and Lake Tahoe. It has all new teak interior and laminate flooring; along with new comfortable seating and cushions inside and outside. It has a bluetooth sound system available inside and out. It has easy stair access to all viewing levels. services.desc: Embark on a private cruise around Lake Tahoe aboard the "Blue Warrior" yacht! Duration 2 - 8 Hours About For the ultimate Lake Tahoe experience, charter the "Blue Warrior," a 20-person private yacht complete with captain & crew. We'll curate the perfect adventure for your private party. Cruise the iconic Emerald Bay, anchoring in crystal blue coves or simply enjoying the calm waters at sunset. Bring your own food and beverages on board, then sip champagne on the sun deck or picnic along the shore of D.L. Bliss State Park.
